metric: document-level BLEU (sacreBLEU) + chrF; per direction, per dataset (no cross-direction mean)

finance.name: Citizens' Budget
finance.description: Plain-language summary of Ghana's annual national budget, published by the Ministry of Finance in English and in several Ghanaian languages. The language editions are human translations of the English edition of the same year.
finance.format: PDF (some with broken or image-only text layers, so text is extracted page by page with Gemini vision)

udhr.name: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
udhr.description: Official human translations of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) across Ghanaian languages, evaluated at document/corpus level against the English reference charter.
udhr.format: XML / Plain text (structured paragraphs from the UN OHCHR & Unicode UDHR project)
